This is the first time I've left a negative review, and I'm sorry.
I left the store without purchasing anything due to the unprofessional attitude I encountered.
A comment was made about my dog, who wasn't present at the time, accompanied by unsolicited advice and, more importantly, given without any knowledge of the specific case and with clear ignorance of the matter.
I consider it a serious matter to offer advice on this matter without adequate expertise, as it risks creating confusion or even harm. Professionalism also involves knowing when it's appropriate to remain silent.

The staff are friendly and the store is well-stocked, but the heat inside makes me think our pet food and accessories aren't being properly stored, especially in the warehouses. I've found boxes of food for sale with traces of mold, and clumping litter that no longer clumps due to the moisture it has absorbed. Business is conducted with greater attention to the end customer, even if they don't speak up.
